svg.aria-label: A tool that checks whether a website is up. It reports the HTTP status code, response time and timestamp, and handles timeouts, SSL errors and connection failures. It started as a Python script and now has a FastAPI backend, a React dashboard with check history, and automated tests that run in GitHub Actions.
